Item: How will the bench become rigid when parked?
Prompt / specification: Swivel and wheel brakes reduce rolling but may not remove caster compliance or floor rocking. Options: Unload casters onto leveling feet or a positive parked base | Use high-quality total-lock casters on a flat floor | Rely on two wheel brakes for planing and clamping

Item: What sets the final bench height?
Prompt / specification: Top build-up, casters, leveling feet, and machine decks all add height after the cabinet is cut. Options: Mock up the complete support stack at the actual task | Use adjustable leveling feet within a defined range | Cut the base to a standard height before choosing casters

Item: How will stored tools be controlled during movement?
Prompt / specification: A short roll across a threshold can shift drawers, blades, clamps, or a heavy machine. Options: Use positive drawer, door, and machine retention | Empty the worktop and lock selected storage before each move | Assume shelf lips and drawer friction are enough
